delivery: Exactly three prewritten static goal templates, derived from canonical Markdown during development. Goal selection retrieves the chosen template; placeholder insertion and student notes are local plain-text operations. No AI API generates or rewrites prompts. The student uses the resulting prompt in their preferred AI to generate notebook content.

modes.selection: Pass mode explicitly from the app-owned new/update journey. This composer option is not a request token or output field. Never infer mode from course titles, source text or strings inside student inputs.

update.heading: # Update my Premed OS notebook: {goal}
update.intro: Update the existing notebook identified by revisionInput using its attached latest saved current-content JSON and the new material I supply. This complete prompt works in a fresh AI chat; the earlier conversation is not needed. Use the shared revision and missing-baseline recovery rules below before proposing the complete updated notebook. For a visual notebook, also supply its required existing image files and asset mapping.

modes.algorithm: Validate mode is new or update and the trusted unfilled template starts with the exact new heading for one of review, assessment or assignment followed by two newlines. In update mode replace that leading heading only with the update heading, two newlines, the update intro and two newlines. Preserve the remainder byte-for-byte. Then insert the same eleven JSON-encoded string/null values in one pass. Never search/replace headings in inserted user text. Preview, clipboard and UTF-8 download all use the resulting one composed string.

replacement: Single-pass literal token replacement using JSON.stringify(value); never rescan replacement values. All values string or null; classPreferences defaults to empty string.
identity: Preview text, clipboard text and UTF-8 .md download bytes come from the same composed string. Do not prepend, append, regenerate or normalize one surface separately.
courseProfiles: No inferred class presets. Use the actual class identity, explicit student preferences, and supplied source evidence. These class values are the complete class-specific input; the five manual course projects are not inspected by this builder.
